5.3 Rights of Class E Common Stock. The powers, special rights and restrictions granted to and imposed on the class of capital stock designated “Class E Common Stock” are as set forth below in this ARTICLE V, Section 5.3 and elsewhere in this Amended and Restated Certificate.
(a) Dividend Rights. The holders of shares of Class E Common Stock, as such, shall not be entitled to receive dividends.
(b) Redemption.
(i) Upon Class F Sunset Time. Each share of Class E Common Stock shall be automatically redeemed by the Corporation without consideration and deemed automatically forfeited by the holder thereof upon the Class F Sunset Time.
(ii) Upon Death, Incapacity, or Cessation of Service for Cause or Service to a Direct Competitor. Each share of Class E Common Stock held by a holder of Class E Common Stock shall be automatically redeemed by the Corporation without consideration and deemed automatically forfeited by such holder upon (A) such holder’s death or Incapacity, (B) such holder’s ceasing to be a Service Provider for Cause or (C) a determination by the Corporation that such holder has commenced employment or other service with a Direct Competitor.
(iii) Following Cessation of Service Other Than for Cause. Except as otherwise provided in ARTICLE V, Sections 5.3(b)(ii) or 5.3(b)(iv), one half of the shares of Class E Common Stock then held by a holder of Class E Common Stock (rounded up to the nearest whole share) shall be automatically redeemed by the Corporation without consideration and deemed automatically forfeited by such holder on each anniversary of such holder’s ceasing to be a Service Provider for any reason other than for Cause.
(iv) Redemption of All Class E Common Stock. Each share of Class E Common Stock shall be automatically redeemed by the Corporation without consideration and deemed automatically forfeited by the holder thereof upon the date and time or the happening of the event that is specified by (A) the affirmative vote of directors representing 80% of the Whole Board, rounded up or down to the nearest whole number (any exact 0.5 rounding up), (B) the holder of the Class F Common Stock then outstanding and (C) the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding.

Any purported Transfer of the share of Class F Common Stock in violation of this ARTICLE V, Section 5.4(c) shall be null and void ab initio, and of no force or effect. 5.6 Voting Rights.
(a) Votes Per Share.
(i) Each holder of shares of Class A Common Stock will be entitled to one vote on all matters submitted to stockholders generally for each share thereof held as of the record date for the determination of the stockholders entitled to vote on such matters.
(ii) Except as required by law, the Class N Common Stock will have no voting rights, and no holder thereof shall be entitled to vote on any matter in such holder’s capacity as such.
(iii) Except as required by law, the holders of Class E Common Stock shall not be entitled to vote generally, and shall have no voting rights, except as specifically set forth in this Amended and Restated Certificate (including, for the avoidance of doubt, with respect to the matters requiring the Requisite Class E Vote and as set forth in Sections 5.4(d)(ii), 5.5(b), and 5.5(d) of ARTICLE V and Section 7.1(d)(ii) of ARTICLE VII). Notwithstanding the foregoing, no share of Class E Common Stock held by (i) a member of the Founder LLC or (ii) a trustee of the Trust shall be entitled to vote on, or be counted as present or outstanding for purposes of determining a quorum with respect to, any such matter, in each case for so long as such holder remains a member of the Founder LLC or a trustee of the Trust, respectively.
(iv) The holder of the Class F Common Stock shall be entitled, in respect of such share, to a number of votes equal to the Applicable Class F Common Stock Vote (as defined below). In addition to the matters specifically set forth in this Amended and Restated Certificate, the holder of the Class F Common Stock shall be entitled to vote on all matters submitted to stockholders generally. The holder of the Class F Common Stock shall be entitled to vote, or consent with respect to, such number of votes as such holder sees fit, up to the aggregate voting power of such share, and all such votes need not be voted in the same manner.

text: 6.2 Vote to Amend Terms of Preferred Stock. Except as otherwise required by law or provided in this Amended and Restated Certificate, holders of Participating Common Stock, Class E Common Stock, Class F Common Stock and Class T Common Stock, as such, shall not be entitled to vote on any amendment to this Amended and Restated Certificate (including any Preferred Stock Designation) that relates solely to the terms of one or more outstanding series of Preferred Stock if the holders of each such affected series are entitled, either separately or together as a class with the holders of one or more other such series, to vote thereon pursuant to this Amended and Restated Certificate (including any Preferred Stock Designation) or pursuant to applicable law. Notwithstanding the foregoing, prior to the Class F Sunset Time, no such amendment shall be effected without the affirmative vote or consent of the holder of the Class F Common Stock then outstanding, voting as a separate class.
title: CHARTER (S-1 EX-3.3, governing document) | Article VI > Section 6.2 Vote to Amend Terms of Preferred Stock

location: Article VI > Section 6.3 Vote to Increase or Decrease Authorized Shares
text: 6.3 Vote to Increase or Decrease Authorized Shares. The number of authorized shares of Preferred Stock may be increased or decreased (but not below the number of shares thereof then outstanding) by the affirmative vote of the holders of a majority of the voting power of all of the outstanding shares of stock of the Corporation entitled to vote thereon, voting together as a single class, without a vote of the holders of the Preferred Stock, or of any series thereof, unless a vote of any such holders is required pursuant to the terms of any Preferred Stock Designation, irrespective of the provisions of Section 242(b)(2) of the Delaware General Corporation Law.

location: Article VII > Section 7.1 Board Size and Election of Directors
text:
7.1 Board Size and Election of Directors. Subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock to elect additional directors under specified circumstances, the total number of authorized directors and the composition of the Board shall be fixed from time to time as follows:
(a) Prior to the Class T Sunset Time, the total number of authorized directors of the Corporation that constitute the Whole Board shall be fixed solely by the Board acting pursuant to a resolution adopted by the affirmative vote of directors representing 80% of the Whole Board, rounded up or down to the nearest whole number (any exact 0.5 rounding up); provided that until the earlier to occur of the Class F Sunset Time or the Class T Sunset Time, such total number of authorized directors of the Corporation must be an odd number. From and after the Class T Sunset Time, the total number of authorized directors of the Corporation that constitute the Whole Board shall be fixed solely by resolution of the Board acting pursuant to a resolution adopted by the affirmative vote of directors representing a majority of the Whole Board.
title: CHARTER (S-1 EX-3.3, governing document) | Article VII > Section 7.1 Board Size and Election of Directors

location: Article VII > Section 7.1 Board Size and Election of Directors
text:
(b) Prior to the Class T Sunset Time, the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding, exclusively and as a separate class, shall be entitled to elect the smallest number of directors that constitutes a majority of the total number of authorized directors of the Corporation (each, a “Class T Director”); provided, however, that prior to the Class F Sunset Time, one such Class T Director shall be designated by the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding as the “Specified Class T Director” and subject to the other requirements set forth in this Amended and Restated Certificate. From and after the Class F Sunset Time, any Specified Class T Director then serving may be elected or removed by the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding without compliance with the provisions of ARTICLE VII, Section 7.1(d). Upon the Class T Sunset Time, the terms of any Class T Directors then serving shall immediately expire and each such person then serving as a Class T Director shall automatically cease to be qualified to serve as, and shall automatically cease to be, a director, in each case unless otherwise approved prior to the Class T Sunset Time by the Board (which approval shall require the affirmative vote of each of the At-Large Directors (as defined below) then serving).
(c) Subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock to elect additional directors under specified circumstances, the Electing Holders, exclusively and voting together as a single class, shall be entitled to elect the balance of the total number of authorized directors of the Corporation (each, an “At-Large Director”).
For the avoidance of doubt, from and after the Class T Sunset Time, all directors of the Corporation shall be elected by the Electing Holders, exclusively and voting together as a single class, as At-Large Directors.
(d) Specified Class T Director Nomination and Removal Requirements.

(i) Notwithstanding any provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate to the contrary but subject to ARTICLE VII, Section 7.1(d)(ii), any nomination or removal without cause of the Specified Class T Director or any change in the Class T Director designated as the Specified Class T Director by the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding shall require, in addition to any other vote or consent required by law or this Amended and Restated Certificate, either the prior approval of the Nominating Committee or the approval of the Requisite Class E Vote obtained in accordance with ARTICLE VII, Section 7.1(d)(ii).

location: Article VII > Section 7.2 Board Structure
text:
7.2 Board Structure.
(a) Prior to the Class F Sunset Time, and subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock to elect additional directors under specified circumstances, at each annual meeting of stockholders, each director of the Corporation shall be elected annually by stockholders and shall hold office until the next annual meeting and until his or her successor is duly elected and qualified or until his or her death, resignation, or removal.
(b) Upon the Class F Sunset Time, the directors of the Corporation (other than any who may be elected by the holders of any series of Preferred Stock entitled to elect additional directors under specified circumstances) shall be divided into three classes as nearly equal in size as is practicable, hereby designated Class I, Class II and Class III. Prior to the Class T Sunset Time, the Class T Directors and At-Large Directors shall be allocated among the classes so that each class includes a proportionate number of Class T Directors and At-Large Directors, as nearly as is practicable. Directors already in office shall be assigned to each class at the time such classification becomes effective in accordance with a resolution or resolutions adopted by the Board. At the first annual meeting of stockholders following the Class F Sunset Time, the term of office of the Class I directors shall expire and Class I directors shall be elected for a full term of three years. At the second annual meeting of stockholders following the Class F Sunset Time, the term of office of the Class II directors shall expire and Class II directors shall be elected for a full term of three years. At the third annual meeting of stockholders following the Class F Sunset Time, the term of office of the Class III directors shall expire and Class III directors shall be elected for a full term of three years.
(c) No decrease in the number of directors constituting the Board shall shorten the term of any incumbent director.

location: Article VII > Section 7.3 Removal; Vacancies
text:
7.3 Removal; Vacancies.
(a) Subject to the terms of this Amended and Restated Certificate with respect to the Specified Class T Director, prior to the Class F Sunset Time, any director elected as provided in ARTICLE VII, Section 7.1 may be removed at any time without cause by the affirmative vote of the holders of the shares of the class or series of capital stock entitled to elect such director or directors given either at a meeting of such stockholders duly called or pursuant to a written consent of stockholders. From and after the Class F Sunset Time, any Class T Director may be removed at any time without cause by the affirmative vote of the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding, given either at a meeting of stockholders duly called or pursuant to a written consent of stockholders. Any director may be removed at any time for cause as provided by law.
(b) Prior to the Class T Sunset Time, and subject to the terms of this Amended and Restated Certificate with respect to the Specified Class T Director, a vacancy or a newly created directorship in any Class T Director seat shall be filled only by vote or written consent in lieu of a meeting of the holder of the Class T Common Stock then outstanding.
(c) Prior to the Class F Sunset Time, and subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock to elect directors and fill vacancies under specified circumstances, a vacancy or a newly created directorship in any At-Large Director seat shall be filled only by (x) the Board in accordance with, and following receipt of, notice from the Founder LLC recommending the person proposed to fill such seat or (y) the vote or written consent in lieu of a meeting of the holders of the class or classes or series entitled to vote in the election of At-Large Directors.
(d) From and after the Class F Sunset Time, and subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock to elect directors and fill vacancies under specified circumstances, any vacancy or newly created directorship in any At-Large Director seat may be filled only by vote of a majority of the remaining members of the Board, although less than a quorum, or by a sole remaining director, and not by stockholders.

location: Article VIII
text: The following provisions are inserted for the management of the business and the conduct of the affairs of the Corporation, and for further definition, limitation and regulation of the powers of the Corporation and of its directors and stockholders:
title: CHARTER (S-1 EX-3.3, governing document) | Article VIII

location: Article VIII > Section 8.1 Board Power
text: 8.1 Board Power. The business and affairs of the Corporation shall be managed by or under the direction of the Board. In addition to the powers and authority expressly conferred by statute or by this Amended and Restated Certificate or the Bylaws of the Corporation, the Board is hereby empowered to exercise all such powers and do all such acts and things as may be exercised or done by the Corporation.

location: Article VIII > Section 8.2 Written Ballot
text: 8.2 Written Ballot. Elections of directors need not be by written ballot unless otherwise provided in the Bylaws of the Corporation.

location: Article VIII > Section 8.3 Amendment of Bylaws
text: 8.3 Amendment of Bylaws. In furtherance and not in limitation of the powers conferred by the Delaware General Corporation Law, the Board acting pursuant to a resolution adopted by a majority of the Whole Board is expressly authorized to adopt, amend, alter or repeal the Bylaws of the Corporation without any action on the part of the stockholders. The Bylaws of the Corporation may also be adopted, amended, altered or repealed by the stockholders of the Corporation. Notwithstanding the foregoing or any other provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate, the Bylaws of the Corporation may not be adopted, amended, altered or repealed except in accordance with the provisions of the Bylaws relating to amendments to the Bylaws.

location: Article VIII > Section 8.4 Special Meetings
text: 8.4 Special Meetings. Subject to the terms of any series of Preferred Stock, special meetings of the stockholders may be called only by (i) the Board acting pursuant to a resolution adopted by a majority of the Whole Board; (ii) the chairperson of the Board; (iii) the chief executive officer of the Corporation; (iv) the president of the Corporation; (v) from and after the Class F Sunset Time, a majority of the At-Large Directors; (vi) prior to the Class F Sunset Time and only with respect to a special meeting at which holders of the Class E Common Stock will be asked to vote on a proposal, the secretary of the Corporation; or (vii) prior to the Class F Sunset Time, the holder of the outstanding Class F Common Stock, but a special meeting may not be called by any other person or persons and, except as provided in clause (vii) of this ARTICLE VIII, Section 8.4, any power of stockholders to call a special meeting of stockholders is specifically denied.
title: CHARTER (S-1 EX-3.3, governing document) | Article VIII > Section 8.4 Special Meetings

location: Article VIII > Section 8.5 Stockholder Action by Written Consent
text: 8.5 Stockholder Action by Written Consent. Subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock, before the Class F Sunset Time and the Class T Sunset Time, stockholders of the Corporation may act by written consent in lieu of a duly called annual or special meeting of the stockholders of the Corporation only with respect to (i) any action to nominate, elect or remove directors or appoint a director to fill any vacancy or newly created directorship; (ii) any action to satisfy any provisions in ARTICLE V, Section 5.3(b)(iv), ARTICLE V, Section 5.4(d), ARTICLE V, Section 5.5(b), ARTICLE V, Section 5.5(c)(i) or ARTICLE V, Section 5.5(d); and (iii) any matter in which stockholders vote together as a single class if such matter is first approved or requested by the Board. Subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock, (A) from and after the Class T Sunset Time, only the holder of the share of Class F Common Stock may act by written consent and (B) from and after the Class F Sunset Time, only the holder of the share of Class T Common Stock may act by written consent, in each case, only with respect to clauses (i)-(iii) set forth in this Section 8.5. Subject to the rights of the holders of any series of Preferred Stock, from and after the occurrence of both the Class F Sunset Time and the Class T Sunset Time, any action required or permitted to be taken by the stockholders of the Corporation must be effected at a duly called annual or special meeting of stockholders of the Corporation and may not be effected by any consent in writing by such stockholders. Notwithstanding the foregoing, any action required or permitted to be taken by the holders of Class E Common Stock must be effected at a duly called annual or special meeting of stockholders of the Corporation and may not be effected by any consent in writing by such stockholders.

text: 8.6 No Cumulative Voting. No stockholder will be permitted to cumulate votes at any election of directors.

location: Article VIII > Section 8.7 Board Quorum
text: 8.7 Board Quorum. At all meetings of the Board, a majority of the Whole Board, including at least one At-Large Director, shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business; provided that, if a quorum is not present at a first called meeting of the Board solely due to the absence of at least one At-Large Director, the meeting may be reconvened at a time no earlier than 48 hours after the originally scheduled time of such first called meeting (with notice of such reconvened meeting given, not less than 24 hours before the time of such reconvened meeting, to each director who was not present at such first called meeting), and at such second called meeting a quorum for the transaction of business shall be deemed present if a majority of the Whole Board is present, regardless of whether any At-Large Director is present. If a quorum is not present at any meeting of the Board, then the directors present thereat may adjourn the meeting from time to time, without notice other than announcement at the meeting, until a quorum is present; provided that, if a quorum is not present at a first called meeting solely due to the absence of at least one At-Large Director, the meeting may be adjourned or reconvened, and business may be transacted at any such adjourned or reconvened meeting, only in accordance with the first sentence of this Section 8.7. The required attendance of an At-Large Director for the purpose of establishing a quorum may be waived by a majority of the At-Large Directors then in office at any time prior to the applicable meeting.

location: Article IX
text:
To the fullest extent permitted by law, no director or officer of the Corporation shall be personally liable for monetary damages for breach of fiduciary duty as a director or officer. Without limiting the effect of the preceding sentence, if the Delaware General Corporation Law is hereafter amended to authorize the further elimination or limitation of the liability of a director or officer, then the liability of a director or officer of the Corporation shall be eliminated or limited to the fullest extent permitted by the Delaware General Corporation Law, as so amended. Any disinterested failure to satisfy Section 365 of the Delaware General Corporation Law shall not, for the purposes of Section 102(b)(7) or Section 145 of the Delaware General Corporation Law, constitute an act or omission not in good faith, or a breach of the duty of loyalty.
No amendment, repeal, or elimination of this ARTICLE IX, or adoption of any provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate inconsistent with this ARTICLE IX, shall eliminate, reduce or otherwise adversely affect any limitation on the personal liability of a director or officer of the Corporation existing at the time of such amendment, repeal, or elimination or adoption of such an inconsistent provision.

location: Article X
text: Prior to the later to occur of (i) the Class F Sunset Time or (ii) the Class T Sunset Time, the Corporation hereby expressly elects not to be governed by Section 203 of the Delaware General Corporation Law. From and after the later to occur of (i) the Class F Sunset Time or (ii) the Class T Sunset Time, the Corporation will be governed by Section 203 of the Delaware General Corporation Law.

location: Article XI
text:
If any provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate becomes or is declared on any ground by a court of competent jurisdiction to be illegal, unenforceable or void, portions of such provision, or such provision in its entirety, to the extent necessary, shall be severed from this Amended and Restated Certificate, and the court will replace such illegal, void or unenforceable provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate with a valid and enforceable provision that most accurately reflects the Corporation’s intent, in order to achieve, to the maximum extent possible, the same economic, business and other purposes of the illegal, void or unenforceable provision. The balance of this Amended and Restated Certificate shall be enforceable in accordance with its terms.
Except as otherwise provided in this Amended and Restated Certificate, the Corporation reserves the right to amend, alter, change or repeal any provision contained in this Amended and Restated Certificate, in the manner now or hereafter prescribed by statute, and all rights conferred upon stockholders herein are granted subject to this reservation; provided, however, that, notwithstanding any other provision of this Amended and Restated Certificate or any provision of law that might otherwise permit a lesser vote and in addition to any vote required by law or by this Amended and Restated Certificate, the affirmative vote of (i) prior to the Class F Sunset Time, a majority of the voting power of the then outstanding shares of capital stock of the Corporation entitled to vote on matters submitted to a vote of stockholders generally or (ii) from and after the Class F Sunset Time, 66 2/3% of the voting power of the then outstanding shares of capital stock of the Corporation entitled to vote on matters submitted to a vote of stockholders generally, in each case, voting together as a single class, shall be required for the amendment, repeal or modification of the provisions of ARTICLE V, Section 6.1 of ARTICLE VI, ARTICLE VII, ARTICLE VIII, or this ARTICLE XI of this Amended and Restated Certificate.
